sealed_data_guard: no sealed data opened; DEV only (djangoCMS 174 + Saleor 149 = 323)
realization_b_usage: robustness rerun ONLY after full V2 freeze; no averaging; no redesign on B

cancelled.name: CALIBRATED_SET_SELECTION_V2_FULL_UNIVERSE
cancelled.basis: V1 non-Sparse selected additions only at ranks 1-4 (172/93/20/3, ranks 5-20 = 0); max non-Sparse outer-OOF prob ranks 5-20 = 0.1880 (p95 0.0886), ranks 15-20 = 0.0650 (p95 0.0428); all V1 thresholds 0.17-0.21 strictly above; top-20 boundary never active at the decision boundary; descriptive decision from exposed DEV/V1 artifacts, NOT a new experiment

deep_dense_miss.definition: historical-proxy positive file that remains a V1 false negative AND was outside the V1 frozen candidate universe (Sparse UNION dense-top20)

history_visibility.rule: strict parent-only: only provable ancestors of parent P via git rev-list
history_visibility.fail_closed: any ancestor commit missing from the local index aborts the task

history_window: ALL available parent-visible production-changing history before P; NO last-N / time-window / recency / 1yr-vs-2yr / 500-vs-2000 tuning; cumulative repository memory frozen
production_file_filter: commit is production-changing iff it touches >=1 file in the task's legal production universe (candidate_universe paths); commits modifying only excluded files are excluded

channel_A_structural_cochange.C_f: number of parent-visible production-changing commits touching f
channel_A_structural_cochange.cochange_sparse: max Jaccard(f,s) over Sparse; 0 if Sparse empty

channel_B_episodic.document: commit subject + body (NO web/API enrichment; no issue text)
channel_B_episodic.retrieval: deterministic BM25 over HISTORICAL CHANGE TEXT (reuses benchmark.cheap_baselines.bm25)
channel_B_episodic.episode_similarity: max normalized BM25 score among retrieved top-10 episodes that modified f; 0 if none (normalization = score / max score within the retrieved top-10)
channel_B_episodic.episode_hit_count: descriptive ONLY; NOT a V2 model feature

file_history_frequency.history_change_count: number of parent-visible production-changing commits touching f

v2_universe_note: the FULL repository universe is NOT used for classification

features.name: dense_file_score
features.nan_handling: impute to min_finite_dense_score - 1.0 (per realization, label-free, frozen)

features.name: log_rank
features.definition: log1p(ABSOLUTE dense_rank), NOT normalized by N

model.preprocessing: StandardScaler on the continuous features ONLY; fit on training rows ONLY; boolean features unscaled

final_set: candidate file included iff predicted_probability >= outer-training threshold

metrics.bootstrap: task-paired, >= 10,000 resamples, fixed seed 20260920 (same seed as V1), CI95 = [Q2.5, Q97.5]

primary_success_gate.B: paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound for Delta F1 > 0
primary_success_gate.precision_handling: always report point estimate + Delta Precision + 95% CI; NO post-hoc Precision margin
primary_success_gate.pareto_success: descriptive only (P> and R> and F1> and FNR< on BOTH repos)

descriptive_only.dependency_cluster_diagnostic: oracle-style; NEVER inference seeds; NO graph features in V2
descriptive_only.deep_fn_coverage_report: after freezing the generator, before fitting; NOT used to modify K/support/features/window
descriptive_only.mechanism_baselines: historical-popularity + seeded deterministic random (seed 20260920, 1000 resamples); NOT used to tune memory
descriptive_only.channel_ablations: remove structural / remove episodic; mechanism understanding only; NOT used to redefine V2
descriptive_only.intent_stratification: buckets <=6 / 7-15 / >15 words; NOT a feature, NOT a gate; descriptive hypothesis-generating only

realization_b_robustness.rule: rerun the EXACT pipeline with Qwen realization B dense scores; report P/R/F1/FNR A-vs-B, exact-set agreement, task Jaccard, PASS/FAIL agreement

decision_rule.PASS: gate on BOTH repos AND realization B preserves the verdict -> PARENT_ONLY_REPOSITORY_MEMORY_RESCUE_V2_PASS
